purpose: Layered concept assets for the interactive ancient-to-modern lunar journey; not documentary mission photography.

assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: single transparent character cutout for a layered cinematic interactive website scene.
Primary request: Chang'e, the Chinese moon goddess, ascending toward the moon, lifelike cinematic historical fantasy with restrained mythic grace.
Subject: one adult Chinese woman in flowing ivory and pale celadon Hanfu with finely woven silk, subtle pale gold embroidery, a traditional elegant updo and small gold hair ornament. Three-quarter full body profile facing right and upward, floating with natural anatomy, both hands graceful and believable. Her body and face are photographic and expressive, not a black silhouette. Long gauzy silk ribbons stream diagonally down and to the left like a comet's tail; every ribbon clearly defined.
Composition: landscape 3:2 transparent PNG, entire figure and ribbons visible, figure centered at 58% horizontal, floating diagonal upward-right; generous transparent margins, no cropping. Intended display height around 300px, keep silhouette readable at this size.
Lighting: physically plausible cool silver moonlight from upper right and very soft warm rim light from lower left. Rich textile microdetail, realistic skin, understated solemn wonder.
Backdrop: true transparent alpha, isolated subject only. No moon, no clouds, no ground, no scenery, no text, no watermark. Premium live-action film VFX cutout, not anime, not doll, not game illustration.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: transparent foreground/environment plate for a layered cinematic moon-journey website.
Primary request: ancient Chinese mythology landscape, physically believable misty mountain ridges with a restrained moon-palace pavilion and one gnarled osmanthus tree on a rocky outcrop, antiquity under silver moonlight.
Composition: wide 3:2 landscape with true transparent alpha above and around the mountains. Mountain ridge and moon-palace pavilion occupy the right third, with lower misty foothills and delicate layered clouds across the bottom third. The tallest ridge reaches halfway up the image on the right. Upper half and left upper two thirds are completely transparent for a separately rendered moon, character, and website content. Small ivory stone steps lead toward the pavilion, credible timber beams, weathered gray-gold roof tiles, refined ancient Chinese roof structure. Moon palace is architectural and luminous, not giant fantasy towers. No people, no moon, no stars, no sky.
Style: photorealistic miniature landscape / feature-film VFX plate, stone grain, realistic layered mountains, moonlit cool slate and muted bronze, silvery volumetric mist with soft transparent edges. Not flat vector, not cartoon, not a poster. No rectangular background, no black matte, no text, no watermarks.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent isolated spacecraft cutout for a Chinese ancient-to-modern lunar journey interactive scene.
Primary request: a believable modern Chinese crew-capable heavy launch rocket, inspired by the structural proportions of a three-core lunar launcher: a tall white central cylindrical multistage core with a tapered upper crew-spacecraft shroud and a slender launch escape tower, two symmetrical white liquid boosters attached alongside the lower half, detailed stage separation rings, small black service panels, thin red geometric markings without words.
Composition: portrait 2:3 transparent PNG, full rocket vertically upright, slight three-quarter view showing cylindrical depth; whole escape tower and every engine nozzle visible, rocket occupies central 36% of image width and 82% height; balanced perspective, engineering-realistic proportions, consistent symmetry. Centered with transparent margins around entire silhouette.
Lighting: realistic silver-white hull in cool daylight from upper right, soft golden bounce light under the engines. Very sharp metal panel details, real white thermal insulation, dark engine bells. No launchpad, no sky, no planet, no smoke, no flames; exhaust and motion are added by code. True transparent background, no drop shadow, no labels, no text, no logos, no watermark. Photographic aerospace realism, not toy, not illustration, not science-fiction spaceship.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent cloud texture plate for a cinematic interactive transition. A single wide, irregular bank of real volumetric silver-gray and pale blue stratus clouds, viewed very close from an aircraft as it passes through the bank. Dense sculpted cloudy folds in the central horizontal band, fine wisps and translucent vapour feathering gently outward on all sides. Soft moonlit silver illumination from upper right, subtle neutral ivory highlights, believable atmospheric depth and detail. Landscape 3:2 composition, cloud body occupies central 70% width and central 45% height with completely transparent empty margins. True transparent alpha background. Clouds and vapor ONLY: absolutely no mountains, no trees, no buildings, no ground, no horizon, no sky, no moon, no stars, no solid rectangle, no border, no text. High resolution photographic VFX cloud element, no cartoon, no cotton-ball icons. All edges must softly disappear into transparency, with no hard cutoffs.
